subject: Clarification: reseller stacking and gross-to-net mapping for Azure private offer
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on reseller stacking for Finovate AZ private offer

Hi Ben / Irene,

Finovate's procurement team surfaced a concern this morning: their reseller (ResellCo) wants a 12% reseller commission on top of a 6% distributor fee that another intermediary is inserting. Effectively the list price gets layered and Finovate expects to see those pass-throughs in the private offer.

Two quick things I want to confirm before I loop the customer back in:
1) Is it acceptable from our marketplace rules to allow stacked pass-through fees in a private offer for Azure, provided we have the correct reseller addendum and evidence routing?
2) If so, do we have a recommended gross-to-net waterfall mapping that procurement/procurement finance teams prefer so accounting can reconcile (e.g., list price -> platform fee -> distributor fee -> reseller commission -> net to Redwood)?

I'm attaching a draft pricing workbook where I tried to model the waterfall and an invoice flow diagram — please flag any pitfalls (tax, VAT handling, invoice recipient) or things legal needs to weigh into.

Goal: respond to Finovate with a clean set of allowed options and the evidence/legal asks by EOD.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Marketplace Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question on reseller stacking for Finovate AZ private offer

Tessa —

Short answer: yes, but with controls. Context and recommended options below.

Options to present (ranked by operational simplicity):
1) Single-invoice path (preferred) — ResellCo invoices Finovate; ResellCo provides an itemized invoice showing the distributor and reseller line items. We accept the private offer list price and Net to Redwood equals list - (platform fee + documented pass-throughs). Require ResellCo to sign reseller addendum and provide two prior invoices as evidence.

2) Netback cap (if Finovate pushes on margin) — Allow stacking but cap total reseller+distributor at X% (recommend 18% combined for this account). Any excess over cap is absorbed by partner or credited back. This simplifies accounting but needs exec approval for the cap.

3) Channel routing (complex) — Pass-throughs allowed but ResellCo must route distributor fees through a verified intermediary and Redwood will only recognize supported intermediary IDs. More manual ops.

Tax note: if the reseller invoices Redwood directly (vs customer), there's VAT/invoice handling implications — legal/tax should confirm.

I'll draft language for the reseller addendum and the evidence checklist. Can you drop the workbook into the thread to send to Finovate?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Deals, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@finovate.com, david.jackson@finovate.com
Cc: alice@resellco.com, ben.carter@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: reseller stacking and gross-to-net mapping for Azure private offer

Hi David / procurement team —

Thanks for the transparency on how ResellCo and your distributor want to structure the pass-throughs. We want to keep this simple and auditable for your finance team. Attached is a proposed worksheet showing:
- Option A: single-invoice path (ResellCo invoices Finovate; itemized pass-throughs)
- Option B: combined cap on channel fees (illustration at an 18% cap)
- Proposed invoice flow diagram (attached)

Action items we propose:
- Please confirm whether Finovate prefers Option A or Option B. If Option A, we need the reseller addendum signed by ResellCo and examples of two recent invoices showing the distributor and reseller lines.
- If Option B, confirm whether Finovate is comfortable with an 18% combined channel cap (we can model alternate caps if needed).

Alice (ResellCo) — could you confirm the standard reseller commission you intend and whether ResellCo will be able to provide itemized invoices that include the distributor fee line? Also indicate who will invoice Finovate.

Attaching: azure_privateoffer_pricing_workbook.xlsx; invoice_flow_diagram.png

Thanks — aiming to get this into procurement/legal by tomorrow so we don't delay the PO window.

Best,
Tessa
From: Alice Park <alice@resellco.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, procurement@finovate.com, david.jackson@finovate.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: reseller stacking and gross-to-net mapping for Azure private offer

Thanks Tessa — looping in a couple folks from ResellCo finance. Quick answers:
- ResellCo standard commission for this engagement would be 12% on top of the distributor fee. The distributor fee is typically 6%, so combined would be 18% total.
- We can provide itemized invoices that show the distributor fee as a separate line.
- Preferred model is that ResellCo invoices Finovate directly (single-invoice path).

Two questions for Redwood:
1) If ResellCo invoices Finovate directly, do you require ResellCo to invoice Redwood at all for reconciliation?
2) What exact evidence do you need for your marketplace controls (samples of prior invoices? signed reseller addendum? tax IDs?)

Appreciate the clarity — happy to sign an addendum if that's required.

Regards,
Alice Park
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@resellco.com>, procurement@finovate.com, david.jackson@finovate.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarification: reseller stacking and gross-to-net mapping for Azure private offer

Hi all —

Thanks Alice — that path is workable. Quick clarifications from Redwood ops/legal side:

Required for single-invoice (ResellCo -> Finovate) route:
- ResellCo must sign our reseller addendum (attached draft) that includes: confirmation of itemized invoice lines, explicit commitment to not re-price after issuance and tax handling responsibilities.
- Two recent itemized invoices showing distributor + reseller lines.
- ResellCo tax ID and statement of jurisdiction for VAT handling.

Alternate (ResellCo invoices Redwood) — slightly simpler tax handling for us but operationally more overhead for Finovate; typically we only require this when the reseller cannot or will not provide itemized invoices.

Operational note: to keep marketplace listing clean we will treat the private offer list price as the customer-facing price. Our accounting will record net to Redwood as list less documented pass-throughs. If you prefer a cap instead of itemization, state the cap and we'll draft the compensation routing.

I've uploaded the reseller addendum draft for signature: https://www.docusign.com/RC/1234-az-reseller-addendum (or we can send via your CLM). Once we have the addendum and invoices we can finalize the PO and push the private offer through.

Irene Choi
Sr. Deal Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: reseller_addendum_draft.pdf
